title: Mobility Equipment Warranty Terms — Early-Wear Allowance on Tires and Casters
content:
# Early-Wear Allowance — Tires and Casters on Mobility Equipment

**Term.** An early-wear allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty tire or caster replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the days from the chair's delivery date to the day the caster claim is posted: 2 units for no more than 14 days, 1 unit for more than 14 but no more than 60 days, and nothing for a longer span.

| Days since delivery at posting | Early-wear allowance |
|---|---|
| up to and including 14 | 2 units |
| 15 through 60 | 1 unit |
| beyond 60 | none |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical, chair delivered 5 October)

- Posted 19 October (14 days): 2 units; posted 20 October (15 days): 1 unit.
- Posted 4 December (60 days): 1 unit; posted 5 December (61 days): none.

The delivery date comes from the chair's wheelchair record.
